Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical calculation error in Step 10 by instructing the CodeExecutor to convert 1,100,000 square feet to square meters. This figure (1,100,000) was completely fabricated and contradicted the consistent data gathered in previous steps (Step 0-9), which repeatedly identified the mall's size as 728,000 square feet. Instead of verifying the correct figure or correcting the hallucinated number, the Planner blindly generated a code snippet to convert the wrong value, leading to an incorrect final result (102,193.30 m² instead of the correct ~67,600 m²). This represents a failure to critically assess the gathered information and a hallucination of a specific numerical value.
